label: For "Site Hazard and PPE Detection": Detect scene-level hazards such as missing edge protection, unguarded openings, blocked exits and exclusion zone breaches from site cameras and alert the safety manager, without identifying or scoring individual workers. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Individual identification.
